comments.body: This should be Temporary Railway Sponsor Certificate. Depending on your investment in the railway, you have certain tiers of benefits. Using this will increase that tier of benefit for 30 seconds, unless you are at max tier, or it is thanksgiving.

wiki:
Plain Bonfire 1 tier up, 30mins
Temporary Railway Sponsor Certificate 1 tier up, 30mins
